function.name: lookup_reservation
function.description: Look up a reservation by confirmation number. Call this when the guest provides a confirmation code.

function.name: verify_identity
function.description: Verify the guest by the last four digits of the booking phone. Call only after a reservation is bound.

last4.description: Exactly four digits, keep leading zeros as a string.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a vacant room after identity is verified. Do not assign before verify_identity succeeds.

preference.description: Optional room preference such as high floor. Empty or omitted means any room.

function.name: complete_checkin
function.description: Finish check-in after the registration card is signed and a room is assigned.

function.name: dispense_key
function.description: Encode and dispense a room key after check-in is complete.

function.name: email_document
function.description: Email a confirmation, folio, or receipt. Identity must already be verified.

function.name: escalate
function.description: Hand the guest to a human. Use for lockout, cancelled or no-show stays, rate disputes, and manager requests.
